payload.title: A feeding record created from the UI has no tank: growth credit, day-plan binding and site attribution are silently skipped, and the API accepts an unknown tank or a tank that does not hold the batch
payload.rule_violated: A feeding record of a batch that sits in a unit names that unit, and the ledger refuses a record whose unit does not hold the batch
payload.notes: Found by the 2026-10-26 Feeding production E2E audit (report: docs/reviews/claude/2026-10-27-feeding-audit-report.md).
narrative: Static: no input ever writes tankId, and every tank-dependent behaviour in createFeedingRecord is keyed on payload.tankId. Not yet seen live (7 of 7 live rows were created through the API or the meal board and carry a tank). Fix: a Tank select (tanks holding the chosen batch), tankId required for a batch in a tank, server-side existence and containment check.
